insurer_name: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: ENT: Sinusitis, Rhinitis, Tonsillitis, Tympanitis, Deviated Nasal Septum, Otitis Media, Adenoiditis, Mastoiditis
Gynecology: PCOD, Uterine Prolapse, Fibroids, Endometriosis, DUB, PID, Menorrhagia
Orthopedic: Gout, RA, Osteoarthritis, Osteoporosis, Prolapsed IV disc, Spondylopathies
Gastro: Gall bladder stones, Cholecystitis, Pancreatitis, Fissure/Fistula/Piles, GERD, Ulcers, Appendicitis
Urogenital: Stones, BHP, Hernia, Hydrocele, Varicocele
Any swelling/tumour/cyst/nodule/polyp; Varicose veins; Congenital internal anomalies

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room/ICU, OT, doctor fees, qualified nurses, medicines, diagnostics, surgical/prosthetic appliances implanted intra-operatively

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH treatment up to SI

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance; inter-hospital transfer for advanced/super-speciality

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Annual cashless health check-up; test panel varies by SI tier

newborn_coverage.notes: Vaccination cover up to 18 years (BCG, OPV, Hep B, DPT, Measles, TT, JE, Hib)

modern_treatments.notes: Activ Health Platinum/Enhanced typically covers modern treatments including HIFU, robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell BMT, IONM, immunotherapy (12 modern treatments per IRDAI standardization)

restoration_benefit.notes: Reload of Sum Insured once per policy year

no_claim_bonus_notes: 10% NCB per claim-free year, cap 50% of base SI; Super NCB optional cap 100%
room_rent_capping: Single Private A/C Room or per Schedule; proportional deduction on excess

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: International Emergency Assistance (Air Ambulance) available as benefit

permanent_exclusions: War, terrorism, nuclear, chemical, biological events
Weight management / obesity (unless BMI criteria for bariatric)
Treatment outside India (unless covered as add-on)
notable_exclusions_summary: Activ Health is ABHI's premium individual product. Covers modern treatments unlike Activ Assure. 36-month PED, 24-month specific waiting, 30-day initial. Includes HealthReturns wellness program.
available_riders: Domestic / International Emergency Assistance with Air Ambulance
claim_process_summary: Cashless or Reimbursement; planned cashless 72 hours notice, emergency 24 hours; authorization issued within 24 hours. Reimbursement claim documents within 30 days of discharge. Settlement within 30 days of last document; penal interest 2% above bank rate.
